Overview of Bangalore’s Rental Market for 1BHK Apartments


Bangalore's rental market for 1BHK flats is booming in 2025, with choices ranging from budget homes in city outskirts to premium, metro-connected apartments in the center. Every month, thousands of job-seekers and students are moving to Bangalore which is applying upward pressure on prices in key corridors (e.g., Whitefield, HSR Layout, sarjapur road , Indiranagar, Marathahalli).

Most renters today want either managed and serviced apartments that will provide a fully furnished 1BHK home effortlessly, Meanwhile, semi-furnished and unfurnished flats are still popular because they’re cheaper and easier to personalize.

Here’s how rent levels look for 1BHK apartments:

Rental Price Breakdown by Key Areas in Bangalore


1) 1BHK apartment cost in Whitefield Bangalore


flats for rent in Whitefield is a top pick for young professionals and families due to its IT parks, modern amenities, and now Purple Line metro connectivity. It has both budget and premium 1BHK options.

Furnishing

Rent Range (₹/month)

Unfurnished

9,000 – 12,000 +

Semi-Furnished

14,000 – 18,000 +

Furnished

26,800 – 35,000 +

Besides main Whitefield, areas like Kundalahalli, Marathahalli, and Hoodi offer slightly cheaper rents with great bus and metro access.


Note: If you're renting for the first time, don't miss our checklist on renting a flat – things to check before renting a house, including legal documents, hidden charges, and landlord responsibilities.


2)1BHK flats price for rent in Electronic City Bangalore


Electronic City is known for affordable 1BHKs and draws techies from across India. The metro extension and proximity to many tech parks keep it in the limelight of the market. 


Furnishing

Rent Range (₹/month)

Unfurnished

9000 – 11,000+

Semi-Furnished

14,000 – 20,000+

Furnished

19,000 – 24,000+

The unfurnished flats there are some of the cheapest in Bangalore, ideal for students and just-starting-young-professionals. The societies there usually have the added bonus of some good amenities, like security and gyms.


3)1BHK flats price for rent in Koramangala Bangalore


Koramangala is a busy central area well-known and loved by students, entrepreneurs, and young families, with both old and new apartments. Being in a premium rental area, fully furnished options will be the most expensive


Furnishing

Rent Range (₹/month)

Unfurnished

15,000 – 20,000+

Semi-Furnished

20,000 – 23,000+

Furnished

30,000 – 45,000+

Public transport and a lively café scene add to the value. You are going to get quality, but be prepared to pay a higher deposit and maintenance.


4)1BHK flats cost for rent in HSR Layout Bangalore


A 1 BHK apartment in HSR Layout is a popular choice for professionals and families looking for a well-planned residential area with excellent amenities. HSR Layout is known for its parks, cafes, and educational institutes. It definitely has a peaceful yet lively environment, with convenient accessibility to Electronic City and Koramangala areas of tech industry with available Public Transport and main roads.


There are multiple choices for flats from budget-friendly to luxurious. HSR Layout is the locality for those who are seeking comfort, convenience, and quality of life in Bangalore.


Furnishing

Rent Range (₹/month)

Unfurnished

13,000 – 15,000+

Semi-Furnished

18,000 – 25,000+

Furnished

29,000 –35,000+

You get spacious flats, clean streets, and good security, typically at better prices than central areas. It's a good idea to ask about society maintenance fees upfront.


5)1BHK flats for rent in Mahadevapura Bangalore


A flats for rent in Mahadevapura is a smart choice for anyone looking to stay close to Bangalore’s major IT hubs like Whitefield and Bagmane Tech Park. With easy public transport and metro connectivity, commuting daily should not be much of a hassle.


The area has furnished and semi-furnished properties at reasonable rents, making it a good area for working professionals, students or couples. Moreover, the options for malls, supermarkets etc., provide you with nearby essentials. You could comfortably say that Mahadevapura is a good option for affordable and well-connected living.


Furnishing

10000 – 12,500+

  • Deposit: 2–6 months' rent
  • Note: Cheaper in non-gated apartments, more expensive in new towers.


6)1BHK apartment for rent in Marathahalli Bangalore


A 1 BHK apartments near Marathahalli is perfect for those working in nearby tech parks like RMZ Ecospace, Cessna Business Park, and ORR. The area is strategically located with excellent road and with the Outer Ring Road and new metro rail lines


The locality has a good mix of affordable and premium options. Marathahalli offers great value for money particularly for young professionals and students. Essential daily needs, supermarkets, restaurants and malls are nearby and makes Marathahalli an easy to live and good option to rent in Bengaluru.


Furnishing

12,000 – 14,000+

Furnished

Major tech parks and malls are close by, so it’s easy for IT people to commute.


7)1BHK flats for rent in Bellandur Bangalore


A nice 1 BHK apartment in Bellandur is a fantastic choice for those working in tech enclaves like Embassy Tech Village, EcoWorld, and Outer Ring Road. The area provides easy access to Sarjapur Road, HSR Layout, and Marathahalli, making daily travel smooth and hassle-free.


Bellandur has a nice collection of gated communities and economical flats, so it's a good blend for singles or couples. Furthermore, you can find a supermarkets, cafés, gyms, and schools are nearby, it's a very nice neighbourhood to live and work in Bangalore.

  • Deposit: 3–7 months' rent

  • Best For: Professionals working along Sarjapur-ORR-Whitefield belt


8)1BHK apartments for rent in Indiranagar Bangalore


A 1 BHK flat in Indiranagar provides a bustling city experience in one of Bangalore's most popular neighborhoods. The appeal of Indiranagar is the multitude of cafes, night life, and shopping destinations, making it a great area for young professionals and artists alike


The location has public transport access, connectivity to other business districts, and accessibility to restaurants and bars, walking distance to the majority, allowing for quick commutes for work and leisure between dinners.


Many furnished and semi-furnished apartments exist, it combines convenience with a trendy lifestyle, ideal for those seeking a dynamic and comfortable living environment.

Here, you mostly find high-end furnished flats, and deposit demands can be up to 10 months’ rent, especially in posh gated societies.

Key Takeaways


  • Costs change a lot depending on locality, furnishing, and nearby amenities.
  • Whitefield, Electronic City, and Marathahalli offer reasonable rents and good connectivity for working people
  • Fully furnished apartments are easiest, but come at a 10-20% higher rent

  • Rents for 1BHKs in Bangalore start as low as ₹9,000 in outskirts and can cross ₹45,000/month in prime areas.


conclusion


Renting a 1BHK apartment in Bangalore goes beyond just rent You'll also need to consider, roughly, location, connectivity, amenities, and additional costs (deposits, maintenance and so on). Being aware of price differences in different areas of Bangalore (Sarjapur Road, Whitefield, Indiranagar, etc.) will help you make a good selection for your requirements, which is hopefully within your budget!

For students, professionals, and small families, balancing affordability with convenience and safety is important. If you put in the time to do some research and comparison, you should be able to find comfortable enough rental accommodation (1BHK style) to suit your needs (and not overspend) in the competitive rental market of Bangalore.


Frequently Asked Questions 


1) What is the average rent for a 1BHK apartment in Bangalore?

The average monthly rent ranges from ₹10,000 to ₹25,000, depending on the location and amenities.


2) Are 1BHK apartments more expensive in central Bangalore?

not all, some area's like Indiranagar, Koramangala and MG Road are expensive and generally starting at ₹20,000 and above


3) What factors affect 1BHK apartment prices in Bangalore?

Location, proximity to tech parks, metro access, furnishing (or lack thereof), age of building and amenities all factor into cost


4)How much should I budget for maintenance in a 1BHK flat?

Maintenance is between ₹ 500- ₹2,000/month, depending on the society and what services are provided.


5)Is it worth buying 1 bhk in Bangalore?

Yes, it is worth buying a 1 BHK in Bangalore for investment purposes or for rental income, especially if located next to an IT hub.
